displayPattern: Amber LED blinking rapidly without a pause on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02)
meaning: Line voltage polarity is reversed, or, on twinned furnaces, the transformers are out of phase. The status table states the polarity fault. The rapid-flashing section is the twinning case.
causes: On twinned furnaces, the transformers are out of phase
diySteps: Confirm the LED is flashing rapidly with no pause. A pause between groups of short and long flashes is a numbered code, not this one
Technician: correct line polarity. On a twinned pair, the same section checks breaker legs and the 115 V leads, then reversing the transformer secondary leads SEC-1 and SEC-2 on the main furnace
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not swap line wires in the furnace to experiment.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
